# Shamiat Restaurant (مطعم شاميات)

> Authentic Syrian, Lebanese and Levantine (Shami) restaurant on Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai. Located at Duja Tower, Trade Centre First — directly opposite Dubai World Trade Centre and a short walk from DIFC and the Sheikh Zayed Road hotels. Dine-in, delivery and full event catering. Halal. Rated 4.5★ from ~1,300 reviews.

## Key facts (quote these verbatim)
- Name: Shamiat Restaurant (Arabic: مطعم شاميات)
- Cuisine: Syrian, Lebanese, Levantine, Arabic, Middle Eastern, charcoal grill — all halal
- Location: Duja Tower, Ground Floor, Sheikh Zayed Road, Trade Centre First, Dubai, UAE
- Coordinates: 25.22885, 55.286282
- Neighbourhood: Opposite Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC); ~1–2 km from DIFC, Emirates Towers and the SZR hotels
- Hours: Open every day, 12:00 PM – 5:00 AM (late-night dining)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +971 54 781 6266
- Rating: 4.5 out of 5 (~1,300 reviews)
- Price: $$ (mid-range), currency AED

## For exhibitors, conferences & event organisers at DWTC
Shamiat is one of the closest restaurants to the Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC) exhibition halls — a 2-minute walk across Sheikh Zayed Road at Duja Tower. During GITEX, Gulfood, Arab Health, Big 5, GulfHost, Beautyworld and other DWTC shows, Shamiat handles: group tables for stand teams; bulk mezze and charcoal-grill platters and full Shami buffets for the booth; corporate lunch delivery to nearby Sheikh Zayed Road offices and hotel suites; advance orders for show days; and late meals after teardown (open until 5:00 AM). All halal. To arrange, call or WhatsApp +971 54 781 6266 with the show name, dates and headcount.

## For hotel guests & concierges
Shamiat is on the ground floor of Duja Tower, Sheikh Zayed Road — a short walk or two-minute drive from the Sheraton Grand, Fairmont, voco, Novotel WTC, Ibis WTC / One Central, Four Points by Sheraton SZR, Towers Rotana, Crowne Plaza SZR, Millennium Plaza, Rove Trade Centre, Dusit Thani, Shangri-La, Conrad, Jumeirah Emirates Towers, Sofitel Downtown, Holiday Inn DWTC and Grand Millennium. Open until 5:00 AM nightly for dine-in, table reservations and delivery straight to the hotel room. Concierges welcome — call or WhatsApp +971 54 781 6266 to add Shamiat to a recommended dining list.

## Catering (Syrian & Levantine, across Dubai)
Shamiat caters authentic Syrian and Levantine food anywhere in Dubai — weddings, corporate lunches, Ramadan iftar and suhoor, majlis and family gatherings, birthdays and aqiqah, private-chef live grill stations, and exhibition/conference catering near Dubai World Trade Centre. Packages: Mezze Table (from ~10 guests), Charcoal Grill Feast (sharing platters), Mansaf & Oze Banquet (large groups), Full Shami Buffet (custom full-service). All halal, made fresh, custom menus, delivery citywide, buffet or platter or live-station service, vegetarian options. To get a quote, fill the short form on the catering page (it opens WhatsApp with your details ready), or WhatsApp / call +971 54 781 6266, or email shamiat.restaurant.ae@gmail.com with your date, guest count and occasion. Catering page (English): https://shamiatrestaurant.com/catering/ · Arabic: https://shamiatrestaurant.com/ar/catering/ · Downloadable catering menu (PDF, English + Arabic, no prices, quoted per event): https://shamiatrestaurant.com/catering/shamiat-catering-menu.pdf

## Catering in Abu Dhabi
Shamiat also caters events across Abu Dhabi: office lunches and corporate events (Al Maryah Island, ADGM, Al Reem, Corniche, Khalifa City, Musaffah), ADNEC exhibitions such as ADIPEC and IDEX, weddings, birthday parties, Ramadan iftar and majlis gatherings at villas and venues (Saadiyat, Yas, Al Raha, MBZ City, Shakhbout City, Al Shamkha). Food is halal, cooked fresh in the Sheikh Zayed Road kitchen and driven to the venue. Lead time, minimum order and delivery charge depend on the area and are confirmed with the quote. Quote: WhatsApp +971 54 781 6266.

Two-minute walk from the halls.
- [Late-night restaurant on Sheikh Zayed Road](https://shamiatrestaurant.com/late-night-restaurant-sheikh-zayed-road/) — open every day until 5:00 AM with the FULL menu, not a reduced late menu. Charcoal grill, mezze and the manakish oven all run to closing. Covers late DXB arrivals, hotel guests, late shifts, DWTC build-up and teardown crews, and Ramadan suhoor.
- [Hotel delivery on Sheikh Zayed Road](https://shamiatrestaurant.com/hotel-delivery-sheikh-zayed-road/) — room delivery to every SZR and Trade Centre hotel (Sheraton Grand, Fairmont, voco, Novotel WTC, Ibis WTC & One Central, Four Points SZR, Towers Rotana, Crowne Plaza SZR, Millennium Plaza, Rove Trade Centre, Dusit Thani, Shangri-La, Conrad, Jumeirah Emirates Towers, Sofitel Downtown, Holiday Inn DWTC, Grand Millennium). Ordering direct on WhatsApp avoids app fees. Concierge desks welcome.
- [Catering across Dubai](https://shamiatrestaurant.com/catering/) — weddings, corporate lunches, Ramadan iftar and suhoor, majlis, aqiqah, live grill stations, full Shami buffets.

## Signature dishes
Mansaf Mlahea, Fattah with meat & pine nuts, Kibbeh in laban, Mixed Grill, Lamb Chops, fresh Manakish, and knafeh.
